subject: Quick question about your quoting process
body:
Hi there,

I noticed your company handles air export quotes. Most forwarders we talk to lose 30% of their RFQs because replies are too slow.

FreightSoft Pro answers every RFQ in under 60 seconds. Could we book 15 minutes this week to show you a demo? Just reply with a time that suits you.

Cheers
Tom Becker
Account Executive, FreightSoft Pro
